records.before_context_paragraph: This is the 14-day national schedule for adolescents and young adults. No numerical age or performance-status boundary is added where the source does not supply one. The treatment starts with ifosfamide/etoposide. The final two even-numbered administrations omit doxorubicin, and dactinomycin remains optional. Trial schedules and other age-group protocols are not interchangeable.

records.before_context_paragraph: This is the 50 mg/m² irinotecan, 100 mg/m² temozolomide, six-cycle Ewing regimen. Other published schedules and the vincristine-containing rhabdomyosarcoma regimen are different. The national source identifies unlicensed indication use: the team must explain the rationale and document consent under local policy, including the source drug-and-therapeutics committee requirement.

records.before_context_paragraph: This is the nine-cycle regimen for high-risk or very-high-risk rhabdomyosarcoma under age 40, with performance status 0–2. It is not one unchanged calendar repeated nine times. Current mesna timing and the different early versus later growth-factor plans are part of the source-specific prescription. Product licensing and the reason for each selected medicine must be reviewed locally.

records.before_context_paragraph: The live national catalogue places this in adult treatment, while the PDF includes a wider age range and age-specific performance scales. Paediatric use requires the appropriate specialist pathway, not automatic extension of this adult portal. Temozolomide escalation and reduction depend on actual previous doses and toxicity; a recovered grade does not erase prior events. The national source identifies unlicensed indication use: the team must explain the rationale and document consent under local policy, including the source drug-and-therapeutics committee requirement.
